headline: NYC Housing Overhaul: $607M to Upgrade 1,148 Apartments
meta_description: Mayor Mamdani announces major investment to modernize public housing in NYC, bringing new kitchens, bathrooms, and climate control to nearly 1,150 apartments.
summary_short: New York City is investing $607 million to modernize 1,148 public housing apartments, serving roughly 2,000 residents with upgraded kitchens, bathrooms, and heating syst…
body:
New York City is investing $607 million to modernize 1,148 public housing apartments, a project announced by Mayor Mamdani that will touch the lives of approximately 2,000 residents.

The renovation scope is comprehensive. Residents will see new kitchens and bathrooms installed, along with upgraded heating and cooling systems—upgrades that address fundamental quality-of-life needs in aging buildings. The project will also include new elevators, improving daily access for elderly and disabled residents.

The scale of the initiative reflects a commitment to public housing infrastructure that has long struggled with deferred maintenance. By focusing on essential systems and appliances, the modernization addresses both comfort and functionality, promising meaningful improvements to homes that serve working families and vulnerable populations across the city.
quick_facts: $607 million investment for public housing modernization
1,148 apartments in New York City to be upgraded
Approximately 2,000 residents will benefit from the project
New kitchens, bathrooms, heating, cooling, and elevators included
